summary: Your feelings don't come in small sizes. You bond deeply and you brace for betrayal, sometimes before there's any reason to. Intimacy feels like power: who has it, who could use it, who might leave.
body: Your feelings don't come in small sizes. You bond deeply and you brace for betrayal, sometimes before there's any reason to. Intimacy feels like power: who has it, who could use it, who might leave. This can make love and control feel tangled until safety is built in the present. You may test the people closest to you, or hold on so tightly you choke the thing you're trying to keep. The work is letting closeness be safe instead of a threat to manage.
gift: At your best: fiercely loyal, emotionally fearless, able to go where others won't.
shadow: The trap: jealousy, testing, and control dressed up as love.
integration: Let emotional needs and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
do: Name the fear of betrayal instead of acting on it
Let people prove safe over time
dont: Read intensity as proof of connection
Try to control your way to safety
